model: Ventura 4 / Ventura 4 DLX (parts list for S/N VP108386 and higher)
notes: Mid-size 4-wheel scooter. The parts diagram covers Ventura 4 and Ventura 4 DLX from serial VP108386.

gaps: The file name says 08_24_2022, while the footer says rev. 08/23/2022.
The manual predates the 2022 parts list, and the source does not say which serials it covers.

Battery size conflicts: the parts list gives 35 AH (LRA402208, 2 needed), the manual 12V x 33AH, Drive's tour page (items VENTURA318FS and VENTURA418FS) gives 12V x 20AH, and Westin Healthcare's Ventura 4-Wheel Deluxe sheet (VENTURA420CS) gives 12V x 33AH in its spec table and bullets but 36AH in...
Charger: the manual and Drive's tour page say 4A offboard, but Westin's Deluxe sheet says 2A offboard; the parts list names the charger LRA402210 with no rating.
method: Two Drive Medical documents were read as text.
The parts diagram PDF is on drivemedical.com.
It gives part numbers for the transaxle, motor, brake, battery, charger, lights and bearings.
(2) The Ventura owner's manual, REV3.08.26.16, in a copy on a Shopify CDN (file 186527.pdf; the host store was not confirmed).
Its spec table gives the motor, controller and charger ratings and covers both 3- and 4-wheel.
The parts list names the controller as part VENT-08 and the motor as part C09-082-00500 (brush SF5012).
The manual names the controller PG S Drive 70A (Westin's sheet: PG 70A).
PG Drives Technology's S-Drive brochure lists the S70 at 70A max. current; it is linked as a datasheet.
The manual describes regenerative braking plus a park brake that locks the drive wheels when stopped, and says to use only sealed lead-acid AGM or gel-cell batteries.

comps.spec: Battery 35 AH, 2 needed, part LRA402208 (parts list item 43)
Transaxle C09-082-00200, part of the motor-transaxle-brake assembly VENT-19N (item 38), which also lists motor C09-082-00500 and motor brush SF5012
Electro magnetic brake, part C09-067-00400 (in item 38, motor-transaxle-brake assembly)

Head light assembly VENT-44 (item 22); turn signals GT8072W35 left and GT8072W36 right, turn signal bulb GT8072W53 (item 14); captain-seat version adds rear light VENT-66 and rear turn lights VENT-67/VENT-68 (item 42). Lamp type (LED or bulb) not stated for the headlight
Turn signal relay, captain-seat version, part VENT-76 (item 10)
Throttle: forward-reverse assembly VENT-01, throttle lever alone VENT-87 (item 1); speed dial assembly S31001 (item 3). The parts list does not say what sensor the throttle uses
Front wheel bearing VENT-25 (item 59); stem bearing set VENT-13 (item 24)
